name: bayes_conditioning_audit

direction_isolation_lnBF.meaning: Evidence carried by the R_ML-aligned component of the mass predictor: the log-evidence cost of stripping that direction from the standard model.

nested_aug_vs_raw_standard.meaning: Marginal evidence for adding log R_ML to raw mass+z. Positive (ln BF = +4.45 +- 1.09, BF = 85.4:1): the nonlinear TEP predictor adds strong positive Bayesian evidence even after raw mass and z are already included, despite the 4-parameter Occam penalty.

nested_aug_vs_tep.meaning: Marginal evidence for adding raw mass+z to the single 9-parameter R_ML predictor (which has no separate baseline secular z term).

conditioning_note: Neither conditioning is neutral. Orthogonalization removes the R_ML-aligned direction from the competitor (TEP-favourable). Raw mass, under the TEP measurement model M_obs = M_true + n*log10 R_ML, contains part of the response itself (standard-favourable). The conditioning-free arbiter is the nested augmented model.

verdict.classification: supportive across nested-augmented, direction-isolation, and residual-space tests
tep_favourable_facts: The nested augmented model (mass + z + log R_ML, ln Z = -1243.8) is the single highest-evidence model in the ensemble, beating the unconditioned raw mass+z baseline (ln Z = -1248.2) by ln BF = +4.45 +- 1.09 (BF = 85.4:1, >4sigma).
The R_ML-aligned direction carries essentially all explanatory variance (direction-isolation ln BF = +55.9); the orthogonal complement of mass space is evidentially inert.
Symmetric conventional residual-space comparison favors TEP by ln BF = +9.1 (BF = 8,720:1, decisive on the Jeffreys scale), and orthogonalized residual space favors TEP by ln BF = +157.9.
standard_favourable_facts: When restricted to a single predictor per observable without a baseline secular z term (9 parameters vs 13), the 13-parameter raw mass+z model exceeds the 9-parameter TEP-only model by ln BF = -14.4.
limitations: SED chi^2 is a fit-quality statistic, not a physical observable; the 3-observable physical subset is the primary observable set.
Astrophysical alternatives are parametric stand-ins, not forward-modelled bursty-SF/IMF/AGN predictions; discrimination against realistic physics alternatives is not tested.
Under the TEP measurement model the raw-mass comparison is contaminated (M_obs contains 0.7*log10 R_ML), so the raw result is not a neutral verdict against TEP.
